title: Price and Inventory is optional when editing products
breadcrumb: Price and Inventory is optional when editing products
label: TIKTOK SHOP · CHANGELOG
subtitle: Updated 2025-01-22
html:
Summary

When calling Edit Product and Partial Edit Product APIs, the price and inventory fields are now optional. This change applies to all markets, and both cross-boar and local sellers. Developers integrated with v202309 version of these endpoints can leverage these changes.

What is changing

The schema of both Edit Product and Partial Edit Product APIs have been changed so that price and inventory are not required anymore. If you omit these objects in the API request, the existing price and inventory will remain unchanged.

What action is required

No action is required unless you are a developer who will gain flexibility by omitting the above fields.

What markets and version is affected

This change applies to all markets and all sellers.
